title: 第10章  筑基成功，老的小的一起揍
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“张奎，你有什么计划？”
宋浩将目光望向了面前的男子。
“浩哥，宋长老不是养了一头实力不逊色于炼气七层的灵兽么，那灵兽性情暴躁，极为凶残，许多喂养这头灵兽的杂役弟子都没能活着回来。”
“我们只需让叶长天去喂养灵兽，再略施手段让灵兽发狂，就可借灵兽之手除掉叶长天。”
“即便叶长天还能侥幸逃过一劫，到时灵兽出了问题，也能让宋长老出手解决他！”
张奎阴恻恻地说道。
“很好，这件事就交给你了，只要解决了叶长天，到时候少不了你的好处。”
宋浩满意地点了点头。
张奎连忙点头哈腰地道：“浩哥放心，包在我身上。”
他张奎原本也只是一名杂役弟子，后来因为脑子比较好使得到了宋浩的赏识，成为了宋浩的狗头军师。
这些年他帮着宋浩在杂役峰欺男霸女，无恶不作。
但也仗着宋浩的关系，在杂役峰捞了不少油水，从而混到了杂役峰执事的位置。
张奎非常清楚，他现在的一切都是宋浩给他的。
想要在杂役峰混下去，他自然要把宋浩伺候得舒舒服服的。
既然宋浩要置叶长天于死地。
那叶长天就必须死！
对于宋浩的谋划，叶长天自然是毫不知情的。
他用两千灵石凝聚的阴阳之力，就轻松将上品筑基丹提升到完美品质。
完美品质的筑基丹，的确霸道无比。
当叶长天吞服下完美筑基丹的那一刻，瞬间化作一股精纯的能量冲刷着叶长天的身体。

叶长天运转阴阳造化诀，开始突破筑基境。
在完美筑基丹的力量下，原本对于伪灵根几乎难以跨越的境界壁垒，仿佛化作了一层薄膜一般，被叶长天轻而易举的捅穿了！
叶长天只感觉自己身体发生了翻天覆地的变化。
原本储存于身体中的灵气，生生在丹田处开辟出了一片气海，形成了一片法力海洋。
开辟气海！
这便是迈入筑基境的标志，也是修行真正的开始。
筑基修士随着气海的不断壮大，实力也会不断增强从而飞天遁地，无所不能！
“这就是筑基境的力量么？”
叶长天感受着筑基境的力量，眼眸中也是浮现出了一抹兴奋的神色。
他只是个伪灵根的废物。
正常情况下，他这辈子都不可能有机会触及到筑基境的门槛。
所幸得到了阴阳造化诀，让他如同开挂一般，短短两天就从炼气一层都没突破的废物，一举迈入了筑基境！
果然是开挂一时爽，一直开挂一直爽！
就在叶长天感受筑基境力量的时候，门外传来了一道突如其来的喝声。
“叶长天！”
叶长天眉头微微一皱，旋即起身
记忆中。
这名杂役峰执事叫张奎，乃是宋浩身边最忠实的走狗。
叶长天不用想都知道。
张奎十有八九就是宋浩派来搞他的啊。

“叶长天，宋长老的灵兽火云鸟今天还没人喂养，你去喂养一下吧。”
张奎也没有废话，直接对叶长天吩咐道。
叶长天眉头一挑：“张执事，我今天已经完成一项任务，这不合规矩吧？”
杂役弟子每天必须完成一项任务。
但只要完成一项任务后，若是再有指派任务，那就有权利拒绝。
“叶长天，你的确可以拒绝。”
张奎皮笑肉不笑地道：“可即便你今天拒绝了，明天这个任务还是你的。”
“好，我去喂养火云鸟。”
叶长天目光一冷。
张奎口中的宋长老，就是宋浩的父亲宋元德。
宋元德养了一只火云鸟，性情极为狂暴，已经不止一位杂役弟子喂养火云鸟的时候被搞死了。
看来宋浩是想用火云鸟来置他于死地啊。
不过——
以叶长天如今筑基境的修为，又岂惧怕一只炼气境的火云鸟？
据说火云鸟乃是上古异种，尤其是内丹非常值钱。
既然张奎让他去喂养火云鸟，他就顺手去将火云鸟给宰了，取了火云鸟的内丹！
接了任务。
叶长天很快就来到宋元德圈养火云鸟的地方。
一只足有一米来高、通体羽毛赤红的巨鸟直接浮现在了叶长天的视线中。
这火云鸟不知道为什么，此刻似乎显得极为狂躁。

它嘴里不断发出阵阵刺耳的啼鸣，巨大的翅膀不断扑腾，撕扯着脚下困住它的巨大铁链，一股股炽热的劲气席卷四方。
按照叶长天的估计。
这火云鸟恐怕至少有着炼气七层的实力。
一般的杂役弟子若是接近此刻的火元鸟，就算不死恐怕也要脱层皮。
叶长天面无表情，一步一步朝着火云鸟走了过去。
那火云鸟显然也发现了叶长天的存在，张嘴便是就是一道炽热的火焰朝着叶长天喷射而来。
叶长天抬手一挥，火焰在他面前化为虚无。
紧接着。
他手掌一翻，对着火云鸟一掌压下。
火云鸟半截身子都被叶长天这一掌压到了地里，瞬间死得不能再死。
一招秒了火云鸟。
叶长天掏出一把匕首划开了火云鸟的胸膛，取出了一枚鸡蛋大小的火红色内丹。
“这火云鸟好歹也是炼气七层的灵兽，肉质应该不错，不能浪费了。”
叶长天自言自语了一句。
他三下五除二地扒光了火云鸟的毛，卸下一个鸟腿，美滋滋地烤了起来。
而就在这时。
尾随叶长天而来的宋浩与张奎终于抵达了现场。
当他们看到场中情形的时候，顿时如同见鬼了一般。
火云鸟死了！
叶长天不仅杀了火云鸟，而且还把火云鸟当作盘中餐烤了！

这……这怎么可能？
火云鸟可是媲美炼气七层的灵兽啊。
“叶……叶长天，你竟然杀了父亲的火云鸟？”
宋浩好一会儿才从震撼中回过神来，嘴角忍不住发出了一阵不可思议的尖叫。
“杀了就杀了，你又能如何？”
叶长天一边烤着鸟腿，一边轻描淡写地说道。
“叶长天，你这是在找死！”
宋浩又惊又怒：“敢杀我父亲的火云鸟，我父亲一定不会放过你。”
“是吗？”
叶长天抬头看宋浩一眼：“给你个机会，把宋元德叫来吧。”
仗着有个炼气九层老爹就来搞我是吧？
今天我就老的小的一起干，把你们一劳永逸地解决掉！
content_en:
"Zhang Kui, what are your plans?"
Song Hao looked at the man in front of him.
"Brother Hao, didn't Elder Song raise a spiritual beast whose strength is not inferior to that of the seventh level of Qi Refining? That spiritual beast has a violent temper and is extremely cruel. Many of the handyman disciples who fed the spiritual beast did not come back alive."
"We only need to let Ye Changtian feed the spirit beast, and then use some tricks to make the spirit beast go crazy, and then we can get rid of Ye Changtian with the help of the spirit beast."
"Even if Ye Changtian is lucky enough to escape, if something goes wrong with the spirit beast, Elder Song can take action to deal with him!"
Zhang Kui said sadly.
"Very good, I'll leave this matter to you. As long as Ye Changtian is solved, your benefits will be indispensable."
Song Hao nodded with satisfaction.
Zhang Kui nodded quickly and said, "Brother Hao, don't worry, I'll take care of you."
Zhang Kui was originally just a handyman disciple, but later he was appreciated by Song Hao because of his better brains, and became Song Hao's dog-headed strategist.
Over the years, he has helped Song Hao bully men and women in the Miscellaneous Peak, doing all kinds of evil.
However, relying on Song Hao's relationship, he made a lot of money in the handyman peak, and thus got the position of the deacon of the handyman peak.
Zhang Kui knew very well that everything he had now was given to him by Song Hao.
If he wanted to survive in the handyman peak, he would naturally have to serve Song Hao comfortably.
Since Song Hao wants to put Ye Changtian to death.
Then Ye Changtian must die!
Naturally, Ye Changtian had no idea about Song Hao's plan.
He used the power of yin and yang condensed by two thousand spirit stones to easily upgrade the top-grade foundation-building pill to perfect quality.
The foundation-building pill of perfect quality is indeed extremely domineering.
The moment Ye Changtian swallowed the Perfect Foundation Establishment Pill, it instantly turned into a stream of pure energy that washed over Ye Changtian's body.
Ye Changtian used the Yin and Yang Creation Technique and began to break through the foundation building realm.
Under the power of the Perfect Foundation Establishment Pill, the realm barrier that was originally almost insurmountable for pseudo-spiritual roots seemed to have turned into a thin film, and was easily pierced by Ye Changtian!
Ye Changtian only felt that his body had undergone earth-shaking changes.
The spiritual energy originally stored in the body has opened up a sea of ​​​​qi in the Dantian, forming a sea of ​​mana.
Open up the air sea!
This is the sign of entering the foundation-building realm and the true beginning of practice.
As the Qi Sea continues to grow, the strength of the foundation-building monks will continue to increase, allowing them to fly into the sky and escape from the earth, becoming omnipotent!
"Is this the power of the Foundation Establishment Realm?"
Ye Changtian felt the power of the Foundation Establishment Realm, and a look of excitement appeared in his eyes.
He is just a piece of trash with fake spiritual roots.
Under normal circumstances, he would never have the chance to reach the threshold of the Foundation Establishment Realm in his life.
Fortunately, he got the Yin-Yang Creation Technique, which made him feel like cheating. In just two days, he went from being a waste with no breakthrough to the first level of Qi Refining to the foundation-building level in one fell swoop!
Sure enough, cheating is fun for a while, and cheating is always fun!
Just when Ye Changtian felt the power of the Foundation Establishment Realm, a sudden shout came from outside the door.
"Ye Changtian!"
Ye Changtian frowned slightly and stood up immediately
in memory.
This handyman peak deacon is named Zhang Kui, and he is the most loyal lackey around Song Hao.
Ye Changtian knew it all without thinking.
Zhang Kui was most likely sent by Song Hao to mess with him.
"Ye Changtian, no one has fed Elder Song's spiritual beast Fire Cloud Bird today. Go and feed it."
Zhang Kui didn't waste any words and directly gave instructions to Ye Changtian.
Ye Changtian raised his eyebrows: "Deacon Zhang, I have completed a task today. Isn't this against the rules?"
The handyman disciples must complete a task every day.
But as long as you complete a task, if you are assigned another task, you have the right to refuse.
"Ye Changtian, you can indeed refuse."
Zhang Kuipi said with a smile: "But even if you refuse today, the task will still be yours tomorrow."
"Okay, I'm going to feed the Fire Cloud Bird."
Ye Changtian's gazeA cold.
The elder Song mentioned by Zhang Kui is Song Hao's father, Song Yuande.
Song Yuande raised a Fire Cloud Bird, which had an extremely violent temperament. More than one of his handyman disciples had been killed while feeding the Fire Cloud Bird.
It seems that Song Hao wants to use Fire Cloud Bird to kill him.
But——
With Ye Changtian's current cultivation level at the Foundation Establishment Realm, how can he be afraid of a Fire Cloud Bird at the Qi Refining Realm?
It is said that the Fire Cloud Bird is an ancient alien species, especially the inner elixir is very valuable.
Since Zhang Kui asked him to feed the Fire Cloud Bird, he killed the Fire Cloud Bird and took the inner elixir of the Fire Cloud Bird!
Accepted the mission.
Ye Changtian soon came to the place where Song Yuande kept Fire Cloud Birds in captivity.
A giant bird with a height of one meter and red feathers appeared directly in Ye Changtian's sight.
This Fire Cloud Bird doesn't know why, but it seems to be extremely manic at the moment.
It kept emitting piercing cries from its mouth, its huge wings kept flapping, tearing at the huge iron chain that trapped it under its feet, and waves of fiery energy swept across all directions.
According to Ye Changtian's estimate.
This Fire Cloud Bird probably has the strength of at least the seventh level of Qi Refining.
If ordinary handyman disciples were to get close to the Fire Origin Bird at this moment, they would probably lose their skin even if they didn't die.
Ye Changtian had no expression on his face and walked towards Huoyunniao step by step.
The Fire Cloud Bird obviously also discovered Ye Changtian's existence. When he opened his mouth, a blazing flame was sprayed towards Ye Changtian.
Ye Changtian raised his hand and waved, and the flames turned into nothingness in front of him.
Immediately afterwards.
He turned his palm and pressed down on Fire Cloud Bird.
Half of Fire Cloud Bird's body was pressed to the ground by Ye Changtian's palm, and he died instantly.
Killed the Fire Cloud Bird in one move.
Ye Changtian took out a dagger and cut open Huoyunniao's chest and took out a fire-red inner elixir the size of an egg.
"This Fire Cloud Bird is also a spiritual beast at the seventh level of Qi Refining after all. The meat should be of good quality and cannot be wasted."
Ye Changtian muttered to himself.
He stripped off the feathers of the Fire Cloud Bird, took off one of the bird's legs, and roasted it happily.
And just then.
Song Hao and Zhang Kui, who followed Ye Changtian, finally arrived at the scene.
When they saw the situation on the field, they suddenly felt like they had seen a ghost.
Fire Cloud Bird is dead!
Ye Changtian not only killed the Fire Cloud Bird, but also roasted the Fire Cloud Bird as a dish!
This...how is this possible?
Fire Cloud Bird is a spiritual beast comparable to the seventh level of Qi Refining.
"Ye...Ye Changtian, you actually killed my father's Fire Cloud Bird?"
It took a while for Song Hao to recover from the shock, and he couldn't help but let out an incredible scream.
"Just kill me, what can you do?"
Ye Changtian said lightly while roasting the bird legs.
"Ye Changtian, you are looking for death!"
Song Hao was shocked and angry: "If you dare to kill my father, Huoyunniao, my father will definitely not let you go."
"Really?"
Ye Changtian raised his head and glanced at Song Hao: "Give you a chance and call Song Yuande over."
Just because I have a ninth-level qi-refining dad, you came to mess with me, right?
Today I will work with the old and the young to get rid of you once and for all!
